disclosure.x46: the X46 growth-separator ceiling refutation (gdn2-fixed 0.93 vs the Welch-bound 0.80) was achieved by the conv-HAVING machine: GDN2's registered block carries the short conv ON (conv_size=4, default), so the refutation is not conv-attributable-in-doubt -- the linear ceiling was derived from the key-space geometry regardless of the conv, and the trained machine exceeded it with ALL its components, conv included
disclosure.silu: the fused SiLU of GDN2's ShortConvolution is NOT transplanted: ours never silus the payload (a standing, pre-existing cross-machine mismatch -- GDN2 silus q/k/v even with the conv OFF, so the conv's own ablated delta in GDN2's family is the temporal filter, and ours isolates the same object); a conv+silu arm would break the 0-flip birth bar by construction
disclosure.qk: the q/k-conv variant (P2 re-registered as decisions conv-influenced) is a NAMED FOLLOW-UP, not this lane: our key/query projections already consume a 4-token causal context window (exactly the conv's receptive-field width), so the payload conv COMPLETES the receptive-field parity GDN2 has on all three sides
